description.zh: 用快捷键（⌘K / Ctrl+K）唤出的浮动搜索面板：输入即筛选命令、页面或内容， 键盘上下选择、回车执行。macOS Spotlight 把它带入大众视野， 现在是效率工具和开发者产品的标配。
description.en: A floating search panel summoned with ⌘K / Ctrl+K: type to filter commands, pages or content, navigate with arrow keys, execute with Enter. Popularized by macOS Spotlight; now standard in power-user products.

use_when.zh: 功能多、层级深的产品（后台、开发工具、笔记软件）
use_when.en: Products with many features and deep hierarchies — admin panels, dev tools, note apps

use_when.zh: 目标用户是高频操作的高阶用户
想减少导航层级、直达任何地方
use_when.en: When you want flat navigation — reach anything in one stroke

avoid_when.zh: 面向大众的浅层应用，用户不知道快捷键文化
avoid_when.en: Mass-market shallow apps — users don't know the shortcut culture

avoid_when.zh: 移动端为主要场景（虚拟键盘体验差），改用底部搜索
avoid_when.en: Mobile-primary contexts — use a bottom search instead

avoid_when.zh: 命令总数极少（< 10 个），普通菜单就够了
avoid_when.en: Very few commands (< 10) — a plain menu suffices

note.zh: 只列操作命令，VS Code 风格
命令 + 页面 + 内容 + 最近使用
自然语言查询 + 建议操作
note.en: Natural language queries with suggested actions

打断程度.en: Medium — covers screen but closes fast

notes.zh: 本质是受控弹层：fixed 居中 + 遮罩模糊；输入过滤用 useMemo 计算分组列表， 焦点锁定在输入框；键盘导航管理 activeIndex。开源实现可参考 cmdk（React）。 注意 aria-role="dialog" 与 focus trap。
notes.en: A controlled overlay: fixed centered + blurred backdrop; filter with useMemo into grouped lists; keep focus locked in the input; manage activeIndex for keyboard nav. The cmdk library is a solid React reference. Use role="dialog" and a focus trap.

basic.zh: 创建一个命令面板组件：⌘K 唤出，输入即筛选命令列表，键盘上下选择、回车执行。
basic.en: "Create a command palette: summon with ⌘K", type to filter commands, arrow keys to navigate, Enter to run.

design.zh: 创建命令面板。要求：屏幕居中浮层 + 半透明遮罩模糊；顶部输入框，下方分组结果列表（命令 / 页面 / 最近使用）；选中项高亮；每项右侧显示快捷键提示；弹出有轻微 scale + fade 动画。视觉参考 macOS Spotlight / Linear。
design.en: Create a command palette: centered overlay with translucent blurred backdrop; top input; grouped results below (commands / pages / recents); highlighted selection; key hints on the right; subtle scale + fade entrance. Visual reference: macOS Spotlight / Linear.

implementation.zh: 用 React 实现受控命令面板：全局 keydown 监听 ⌘K/Ctrl+K 开关；role="dialog" + focus trap；输入 useMemo 过滤 + 分组；activeIndex 键盘导航（↑↓ Enter）；点击遮罩关闭。可参考 cmdk 的 API 设计但自行实现，不引入依赖。
implementation.en: "Implement a controlled palette in React: global ⌘K/Ctrl+K listener; role="dialog" + focus trap; useMemo filtering + grouping; activeIndex keyboard nav (↑↓ Enter); close on backdrop click. Model the API on cmdk but implement yourself", no new deps.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现命令面板（Command Palette）。

先检查现有弹层 / Dialog 组件与 Design Token，优先复用。
要求：
- ⌘K / Ctrl+K 全局唤出，Esc 关闭
- 输入即筛，结果按「命令 / 页面」分组
- 完整键盘导航与 aria 属性（dialog、listbox、option）
- 弹出动画轻微，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 支持注册自定义命令（提供 useCommands 或类似 API）
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Command Palette in the current project.

Inspect existing dialog primitives and design tokens first; reuse them.
Requirements:
- Global ⌘K / Ctrl+K toggle, Esc to close
- Filter-as-you-type, grouped results (commands / pages)
- Full keyboard nav + aria attributes (dialog, listbox, option)
- Subtle entrance animation, respects prefers-reduced-motion
- Custom command registration (a useCommands-like API)
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 打开面板，输入关键词，再尝试选择命令与退出。
task.en: Open the palette, type a query, select a command and dismiss it.

checks.zh: 搜索应覆盖命令别名，并给出无结果反馈。
checks.en: Search command aliases and explain empty results.

checks.zh: 关闭后焦点应回到触发入口。
checks.en: Return focus to the trigger after closing.
